p:cNvPr.name: MS Brand colors
p:cNvPr.descr: These are Microsoft Brand colors. The color bar is placed to the side of the Theme master so that it will be visible on all slides. Users can use the 'eye dropper' color tools under Color Fill Shape, Color Fill line etc. to easily select Brand colors.
